summary.name: Panda-Office.com
summary.one_liner: A listing page offering the expired .com domain panda-office.com for sale at $195 via Afternic / GoDaddy.
use_cases: Buying an expired .com domain for a brand
Evaluating a domain's SEO metrics before purchase
Acquiring a domain with existing backlinks
Finding a descriptive name for a niche business
summary.what_it_does: The page is a for-sale listing for the domain panda-office.com, priced at $195 with a buy-it-now option through Afternic and GoDaddy checkout. It shows third-party-style metrics for the domain: Moz DA 5, Moz PA 14, Citation Flow 7, spam score -1, and 582 referring domains. It also lists a brandability check (12 characters, one dash, no numbers, passes a radio test) and history data (about 1 year old by its listing, 54 Wayback snapshots, first seen 2004). The rest of the text is marketing copy and a description of GoDaddy as a registrar.
notable: Buy-it-now price of $195 via Afternic or GoDaddy checkout
Shows Moz DA, Citation Flow and referring domain counts for the domain
Listed in a collective AI tools list under Design as a material website for design and PPT templates
caveats: Some advanced metrics require a free account
Metrics are described as verified at the time of listing and may have changed
Age figure ('1 years old') conflicts with 'First seen 2004' on the same page
